summary: The reported TritonAMDGPUCanonicalizePointers failure is not present with the prepared ROCm 7.2/Triton 3.7 stack on gfx950. The exact historical kernel shape compiles and matches an independent PyTorch reference. Current main has also removed store_cache_4d and its 4-D layout in favor of dense unified-memory KV views. This change registers the current replacement regression on AMD CI instead of restoring the obsolete test or applying the unmerged workaround.

tests.what_was_measured: Compilation and exact GPU parity of the historical pointer-merge Triton kernel for page_size 1 and 4, int64 and int32 locations, equal and asymmetric K/V row widths, and first/interior/last slot boundaries.
13 replacement-layout regressions, including the real GPU set_kv_buffer write path at page sizes 1 and 4 against an independent strided-envelope oracle.
The current replacement regression is collected for stage-b-test-1-gpu-small-amd after the registration change.
Syntax validity of the changed Python files.

gpu_evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-; historical Triton kernel and current set_kv_buffer replacement path executed on HIP and passed exact numerical references.
remaining_limitations: The assigned GPU is gfx950, not the originally reported gfx942 MI300/MI325 lane; this does not qualify gfx942-specific behavior.
The original failing image/older Triton build was not available, so a failing-before compiler crash could not be preserved locally.
No full model, model weights, serving path, or multi-node workload was exercised; the issue concerns a standalone KV-store kernel.
The result establishes non-reproduction on the prepared ROCm 7.2.26015/Triton 3.7 stack and current source, not that every ROCm 7.2 package revision is fixed.
